Builddrone 0.4.3 is a security release. It closes a remaining archiver symlink
bypass where a folder-root directory symlink was still walked and packed into
published zip archives.

**Documentation:** https://nepitwin.github.io/Builddrone/latest/

---

## Security fixes

### Archiver folder-root symlink rejection

`archiver` now rejects `folders` entries whose resolved path is a directory
symlink before `os.walk`. Nested folder walks still use `followlinks=False`,
and symlinked files continue to be skipped with a warning.

This prevents a contributor from replacing a listed archive folder such as
`results` or `result` with a directory symlink so that CI-readable host or
secrets files are packed as regular zip entries and published by a later
upload or artifact step.
